value.title: Store: conversation tables + turn payload + windowed reads

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Store layer for conversations: two ref-layer tables per workshop 005, elements as the retrieval entry point (research-proven mandatory: search, spend guard and GC all root at elements), and the reference predicates taught that a conversation is a root of reference.

value.title: Migration (NEXT FREE number on freshly-pulled main; 0012 taken by w-update-truth): conversations + turns tables per workshop 005 DDL (anchor columns, source, head_sha, items JSONB, blob_sha bridge); DROP + re-add elements_kind_known CHECK adding turn (0004_content_layer.sql:77 names the constraint)
value.note: 0013_conversations.sql on 7a2dd8a (PR #30). NEXT FREE confirmed after w-update-truth's 0012 merged mid-packet (rebased onto b3a5889). Anchor is TEXT repo_identity with NO FK, reversing the workshop DDL sketch on measured evidence (roots.rs:173 deletes the repos row, so an FK breaks every remove of an anchored repo) - ruled by Jordan via o-prime 2026-08-27. Constraint is at 0004:72-73, not :77.

value.title: ElementKind::Turn end to end: core/src/element.rs:33 enum + as_str, store/src/elements.rs:208 kind_from_str (currently Corrupt on unknown), and prove SummarizeJob (daemon/src/enrich.rs:59) round-trips a turn element -- without this the CHECK widening is unreachable from Rust
value.note: ElementKind::Turn in core/src/element.rs + store kind_from_str, and enrich.rs test a_turn_element_rides_the_ordinary_summarize_job proves the job round-trips a turn element and still dedupes on content (4ca5421).

value.title: Canonical stored form: deterministic serialisation of one turn (body + shaped items) whose content_hash IS the turn blob_sha; identical turns across conversations hash identically so dedupe shares enrichment; elements unique key safe because address differs (0004:70)
value.note: fs3_core::conversation::Turn::canonical + blob_sha. Content only - no timestamp, role or sha - so identical turns hash identically; proven by identical_content_hashes_identically_across_conversations and, at the store, identical_turns_in_two_conversations_share_one_enrichment_key.

value.title: Turn-to-element write: inserting turns creates elements rows (kind=turn, address conv:<guid>#t<ord>, span = ordinal, raw_text = canonical form, enrich by size gate); idempotent with the turn append
value.note: store::conversations::append_turns writes turn and element in ONE transaction under reserved parser_version conversation/1. NEW: the reserved namespace is load-bearing, not tidy - get_elements (elements.rs:148-156) hard-fails on a (blob_sha, parser_version) pair without exactly one file root, so a canonical form hashing equal to a source blob would corrupt that file's next scan. Proven by a_turn_element_is_invisible_to_a_code_scan_of_the_same_bytes.

value.title: Second reference leg, ALL FIVE SITES: raw_hash_is_referenced (store/src/roots.rs:225), UNREFERENCED_JOBS (:353), DELETE_UNREFERENCED_JOBS (:361), UNREFERENCED_ELEMENTS (:373), DELETE_UNREFERENCED_ELEMENTS (:379) each gain OR EXISTS against turns.blob_sha; mutation-checked gc test: imported conversation with NO registered worktree survives a full sweep intact
value.note: All five sites carry the leg, written ONCE as a concat!-spliced macro (held_by_a_live_root!) so five copies cannot drift. MUTATION-CHECKED: removing the turns leg fails a_conversation_no_worktree_holds_survives_a_full_gc_sweep (elements reclaimed 1, expected 0) and removing_a_conversation_spares_a_twins_turn_and_the_shared_summary (summaries reclaimed 1, expected 0); restored, 13/13 green.

value.title: Store read/manage fns: window(conversation_id, turn_no, before, after) ordered + honest at edges; outline(conversation_id); list_conversations(filter by anchor repo/path prefix, with turn counts + started_at); delete_conversation(guid) removing conversation + turns + their elements rows (chain then reclaimed by normal gc); conversation upsert + idempotent turn append
value.note: store::conversations: window (honest at both edges), outline (lean: first line + item count), list_conversations (anchor filters; path is a true prefix, not a LIKE pattern), delete_conversation (by ADDRESS prefix, so a twin's identical turn survives), upsert_conversation (COALESCE anchors/title, LEAST started_at) and idempotent append_turns.
